verdict.rationale: TaxJar is a sales-tax calculation, reporting and filing SaaS with a REST API and language clients. It is not an AI agent or host that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI assistant or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
